title: A Primer on CBO's Projections of Federal Receipts and Expenditures in the National Income and Product Accounts
summary_raw: CBO explains the differences between revenues, outlays, and deficits in the federal budget and the corresponding measures of federal receipts, expenditures, and saving in the national income and product accounts.

title: CBO's Projections of Federal Receipts and Expenditures in the National Income and Product Accounts: 2026 to 2036
summary_raw: CBO presents its projections of revenues and outlays for the 2026–2036 period translated into projections of current federal receipts and expenditures in the national income and product accounts.
